name: Broad validation (full Vitest suite, Linux container)
description: Build artifacts then run the full Vitest suite in a Linux container. The suite is container-equivalent: OS-specific code (Windows registry, scheduled tasks, .lnk shortcuts, VS Code/APPDATA paths) is tested through injected platform/execFile params and tmpdir-scoped env, not real syscalls, so all 317 test files pass on Linux once dist/ and src/dashboard-ui/routeTree.gen.ts are generated by the build.

execution.networkJustification: npm install requires the public npm registry to install dependencies; node_modules is not pre-staged. No other network access is needed once install completes.

commands.name: install
commands.note: npm install, NOT npm ci: the committed package-lock.json is generated on the Windows dev machine and, per npm's cross-platform optional-dependency handling, omits the Linux ideal-tree entries for electron-builder's optional electron-builder-squirrel-windows subtree (app-builder-lib, @electron/*, etc.). npm ci hard-fails on Linux with 'Missing ... from lock file'; a lock regenerated on Linux would then fail npm ci on Windows (it drops the Windows-only entries). npm install reconciles per-platform without a frozen lock. The squirrel-windows subtree is only used for Windows installer packaging (electron-builder), never by this build/typecheck/test lane. Verified 2026-07-19 on the VPS (Linux x86_64, Node 22.22): install+build+typecheck+typecheck:ui green, full suite 356 files / 2309 tests passed.

commands.name: typecheck
commands.run: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:ui

liveExecution.approvalReason: Project owner approved the live VPS Docker run with bridge networking for npm ci.
